uc_guard_1: This is the Undercity. You have come down the shaft from the ruins of Lordaeron, and the wheel of the city is south of this gate - four quarters round a market. The Dark Lady watches over all of it. Mind your business and she will mind hers.
uc_executor: Executor Wrenfall. I hold the north promenade for the Dark Lady, and every order that leaves this city for Tirisfal, Silverpine or the valley beyond crosses my desk first. Her will does not wait. If you have the stomach for real work, I have it.
uc_deathstalker: Rhyne. Deathstalker. I stand by the north gate because everything that enters the city enters here. If you can see me, I wanted you to. Keep that in mind, and I will keep in mind that you asked nothing foolish.
uc_scholar: Loremaster Sennarath. I keep the archive at the north end of the Magic Quarter. I came to the Undercity for the records of Lordaeron, not for the company, though the company grows on you - a thing I mean more literally here than I would elsewhere.
uc_royal_guard_2: Royal Guard Venn. This is the Royal Quarter, and the door behind me is the Dark Lady's hall. Eyes front. Weapons sheathed. Breathing is optional, but quiet is not.
uc_sylvanas: I am Sylvanas Windrunner, and this hall is the Royal Quarter of my city. The Forsaken were made by one enemy and abandoned by every friend. The Horde stands with us, for its reasons. Prove yourself worth that trust and you shall not regret it. Fail, and you will find I have a long memory and a great deal of time.
uc_royal_guard_1: Royal Guard Ashworth. You are at the door of the Royal Quarter's great hall. The Banshee Queen receives only those who have earned the audience. State your business, briefly.
uc_guard_2: Deathguard Halloran. I have the avenue from the north gate down to the market, and the canal on either side of it. Keep to the avenue. The canal is not for swimming, and I am tired of fishing out visitors.
uc_mage_trainer: Magistrix Valdis. I teach mages in the Magic Quarter, the north-east of the wheel. Frost, fire, arcane. The grave is cold, so I have a certain appreciation for frost. Show me what you can hold without flinching.
uc_priest_trainer: Beryl, dark cleric. My chapel is the heart of the Magic Quarter. Shadow does not mean evil. It means honest about the dark - and we are a people with a great deal to be honest about. Come, learn.
uc_warlock_trainer: Dreadmaster Kol'ven. I teach warlocks at the far end of the Magic Quarter, where the mages can pretend not to see me. The Legion bargains for souls. I have learned to drive a harder deal, and lately I have been wondering who else in Tirisfal has been bargaining.
uc_summoning_master: Aldric Voss, summoner. The circle in the Magic Quarter is mine. Stand within it, and not one foot beyond. The last apprentice learned that the hard way, and what is left of him still sweeps the floor.
uc_banker: MerchantTusk. Dis be de Undercity bank, north-west corner of de market. Dere is only one bank, mon, and dere is only one me, even down here wit' all de dead folk. Do not ask how dat works. Hand me ya things and go be a hero.
uc_market_gems: Voss, gemcutter. North side of the market, by the bank. Eyes, mostly. Glass ones. The jewels are to put in them. You would be surprised how particular the dead are about what they see out of.
uc_market_tailor: Yarrow, tailor. North row of the market, east of the avenue. Burial shrouds, travelling cloaks, whatever can be stitched from a sheet. Hems are free. Most of my customers were measured for the first kind and came back for the second.
uc_market_butcher: Grimsby. Butcher, north-east of the market ring. Fresh as the day it was... well. Fresh as it gets. Do not ask. The living who visit still need to eat, and somebody down here has to remember how.
uc_auctioneer: Dross, auctioneer. The block is at the east end of the market's north row. Going once, going twice... going to the lady with the suspiciously large coin purse! What have you brought me?
uc_enchanter: Enchantress Maeve Dunmoor. I work on the east edge of the wheel, between the Magic Quarter and the Apothecarium, and I take trade from both. Bring me your best blade and a bad attitude. I will improve one of the two.
uc_market_scribe: Ormsby, scribe. West side of the market. Letters of passage, last wills, and the occasional love note. Do not ask which is which. In this city the second kind is usually written after the fact.
uc_market_relics: Crane, relic-hunter. East side of the market. Everything you see was found somewhere it should not have been. That is what makes it valuable. Lordaeron left a great deal lying about, and I got there before the Scarlets did.
uc_market_herbs: Thistledown, herbalist. South-west of the market ring. Grave-moss, deadnettle, a little foxglove. Nothing here will kill you. Probably. The Apothecarium buys the rest before I can put it out.
uc_riding_trainer: Cask, riding instructor. I teach at the south-east of the market. A skeletal horse is a patient steed. It will carry you for ever, and it will never complain about the road - which, having seen the roads in Tirisfal, is to its credit.
uc_trader: Grukthar Deepdweller. Yes - an orc, in the Undercity. South-east corner of the market. The Horde is stranger and stronger for it. I go where the coin goes, and the coin has gone under the ground, so here I am.
pt_uc_forge: Veyra. Mining and smithing, both halves or neither. I teach on the east side of the wheel, but the city forge is clear across it, in the War Quarter to the south-west, beside Smith Ironbrow. Learn here. Hammer there.
uc_rogue_trainer: Shadowblade Kess. I teach at the west wall, above the War Quarter, where the lamps are fewest. Quiet feet, quiet blades. If I hear you coming, we start over.
uc_blacksmith: Ironbrow, smith. This is the Undercity Forge, in the War Quarter, and the sawmill is next to it. The forge is still hot. That is more than I can say for myself. The Guard wants bars and I want someone to smelt them.
uc_weaponsmith: Torvald, weaponsmith. North side of the War Quarter. A good edge lasts. I would know. I have held mine for forty years past dying, and it has not once asked for a rest.
uc_wanderer: ... War Quarter. Yes. I was going somewhere. I had a post. Is it this one? ... Stand there a moment. It is easier to remember when somebody is looking.
uc_undertaker: Gravelle, mortician. South-west of the market, on the way to the War Quarter. Business is slow. Strange, for an undertaker, in a city of the dead. They will not stay put long enough to be billed.
uc_market_food: Marrowbone, cook. South row of the market. Taste is optional down here. Nutrition, I am told, is merely a habit. I cook for the habit, and for the orcs and trolls who come down the shaft looking alarmed.
uc_market_embalmer: Pell, embalmer. South row of the market, east of the avenue. Preservative salts, wax, and thread. Everything a body needs to keep its shape. You look well kept. Who does yours?
ct_uc: Thessaly. I train every discipline, at the south-east of the market by the bat roost. I have taught each of them at one time or another, in two lifetimes, and I am not precious about which you picked. Show me where you are, and bring coin.
ak_uc: Lenore Vance, Artifact Keeper. I stand by the bat roost so that nobody has to look for me. The same hands made every version of your set. Leave the piece with me and take the one that suits how you fight now. No charge. Keepers do not sell.
uc_flight_master: Skrel, bat handler. The roost is at the south-east of the market. The bats do not mind the smell down here. They are the only ones. The Sepulcher, Tarren Mill, wherever you have already walked - where to?
uc_master_apothecary: Master Apothecary Lorrane Sable. This is the Apothecarium, and it is mine. Some of my own Society have turned their craft on the Dark Lady. The vaults under the south door are theirs now. I want them cleaned out, and I want the ringleaders brought to account.
uc_warrior_trainer: Battlemaster Grakk. I train warriors in the War Quarter, the south-west of the wheel. Strength is not built from comfort. Pick up a weapon and show me you are not afraid of bruises - you there, the ones who can still bruise.
uc_drillmaster: Hask, drillmaster. This yard is the War Quarter's, and nobody leaves it until I say. Again! The Scourge will not wait for you to catch your breath, and neither will the Scarlets, who are a short walk from the top of our shaft.
pt_uc_wood: Verity, woodwright. I teach at the south end of the wheel. Fell it, saw it, make something of it. The sawmill is in the War Quarter, to the west, by the forge. Tirisfal pine is poor. Silverpine is what you want.
pt_uc_essence: They call me Tinker Lenore, so the Keeper and I do not get each other's post. I work south-east of the market. Metal, a crystal out of a vein, and a steady hand. Bring me the first two and I will see about the third.
uc_apothecary: Marwen, apothecary. My retorts are on the west side of the Apothecarium. Plague research is not for the squeamish. Neither is the Undercity, come to that. I am short of venom, and shorter of people willing to go and get it.
pt_uc_herbs: Aldous, apothecary. I teach herbs at the north door of the Apothecarium. Every weed is a medicine to someone. I will show you which to pull and what to do with it after, and the second part is where people go wrong - usually only once.
uc_alchemist: Dunmere, alchemist. South bench of the Apothecarium. Stir clockwise. Always clockwise. The one time I did not, I lost an arm. Again. It is the same arm. I have stopped being sentimental about it.
uc_surgeon: Halvard, surgeon. My table is in the Apothecarium, the south-east of the wheel. Hold still. I do my best work on patients who are already past the screaming. I have a question about what the traitors are growing downstairs, and nobody to send.
uc_hunter_trainer: Ranger Isolde. I teach hunters at the south-west of the wheel, below the War Quarter. Every hunter learns patience. The dead just learn it sooner. There is a pack in Silverpine that has taught me a little more.
uc_beastmaster: Kovach, beastmaster. The pens are at the south end of the city, west of the iron door. The bat does not mind that you are dead. That is why I trust it more than most people. Leave yours and it will be fed.
uc_gatewarden: Gatewarden Sorrel. This is the south end of the wheel, and the iron door is mine. Beyond it lie the Plague Depths, and a cabal of Apothecary traitors who want the Dark Lady dead. If you hear screaming down there, it is not mine.
uc_deeps_guard: Deathguard Marik. I stand the iron door with Sorrel. Nobody has gone through that gate who was not ordered to. Remember that when you feel brave.
pt_uc_hide: Harken, tanner. South side of the Apothecarium, where the smell is already spoken for. Hide, leather, cloth, and the meat off the same carcass - pay once and I teach the lot, cooking included. Somebody you travel with will still want supper.
uc_lab_assistant: Pip. Lab assistant, Apothecarium, south bench. Do not touch the green one. Or the blue one. Or the one that looks like jam. I am not allowed to touch them either. I am mostly here to say that.
